note: The Zel'dovich approximation is consistently the best scheme tested; truncating highly nonlinear Fourier modes makes it excellent even for an n = +1 spectrum; Abstract supports the truncated Zel'dovich approximation. A follow-up, [Optimizing the Zel'dovich approximation](https://consensus.app/papers/details/w:fc17b056-181a-49c3-9292-45d70bd0caa5/?utm_source=claude_desktop) (Melott et al. 1994), found a Gaussian window better than the sharp cut-off used here.
